ModMetaData.name: Helixien Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Alpha Animals's AA_Helixien art (south/east/north facings only) with a render generated for this campaign (Cauldron sheet 2026-10-04 and Warscar sheet 2026-10-05, owner pick B; the same picture ships as RM_Bileworm in the Warscar). ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_Helixien/AA_Helixien_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution. The dessicated graphic stays the donor's.
